shrine.sakura_bloom.task.watch: Defeat 3 dusk foxes, inkmane wolves or gloam hares
shrine.sakura_bloom.task.ink: Gather 4 ink sacs to restore faded prayers
shrine.sakura_bloom.task.crystal: Gather 3 amethyst shards to mend a shrine bell
shrine.sakura_bloom.offer: The maiden asks, “%s. Will you help?” Speak again to accept. Sneak or hold Blossom Scrip to trade.
shrine.sakura_bloom.accept: Commission accepted: %s. Report to any shrine maiden.
shrine.sakura_bloom.thanks: The maiden gives you 4 Blossom Scrip. Commissions fulfilled: %s/%s.
shrine.sakura_bloom.fan: “This maple fan is called Kamikakushi. Follow its wind into the Interstice.” You receive the fan and 4 Blossom Scrip.
shrine.sakura_bloom.pray: Offering received. Use the box with an empty hand to pray.
shrine.sakura_bloom.deposit: Offer one Blossom Scrip, then pray with an empty hand.
shrine.sakura_bloom.blessing: A bell sounds. A shrine gift rests in your hand.
